title: Thus Done
subtitle: 数据统计 · 主题语境阅读
theme: 数据统计（科学与技术·数据与统计）
meta: 主题语境：数据统计（科学与技术·数据与统计）　|　核心词汇：thus　|　正文 319 words　|　高三一轮复习
intro: 请阅读文章，根据上下文判断每一处 thus 的位置与含义，再完成 Task 1—Task 3。
passage: ① Thus, in 1956 the teacher began the ruler at the blackboard, and everybody in the classroom said it was the first time anybody had done such a thing there. Three terms on, people still spoke of that morning: before the March rains the teacher had ② thus begun the ruler, and nobody had asked a single question. The teacher had come to the classroom two terms earlier, and spoke little of the classroom he had left behind him.

The notebook for March 1950 puts it plainer. The ruler was ③ thus clear, and the pupil who kept it had ④ thus copied it twice before the winter came; nothing in the classroom was ever done thus in those days. The pupil wrote that line himself and read it aloud once every term thereafter.

My uncle, who kept the ruler at the far blackboard, meant something else. He began the ruler ⑤ thus in public, and nobody in the classroom doubted it; of all who began it that term, he began it ⑥ thus before dawn. He was not a man who explained himself, and the classroom had long since stopped asking him to.

By 1963 the matter had shrunk to half a line in the notebook. What the line asked for was that the ruler be copied ⑦ thus every term, and that whoever did it be ⑧ thus careful about the whole business. Everybody laughed at the wording, and then did exactly what it said, as they always did. Everybody there knew the work had been done thus.

My mother said nothing at all. In 1966 she began the ruler ⑨ thus before dawn when nobody else would, and ⑩ Thus, she said in 1968, that was the part the classroom never forgot; the notebook still speaks thus of it. She kept the ruler in the same blackboard for thirty years afterwards, and never once said why; the classroom never forgot how thus it had been done.

task1.title: Task 1　语境辨义
task1.intro: 请为文中十处画线形式选择对应的用法说明。
options: A. adv. 因此（句中状语，置于助动词之后／动词之前：had thus begun …，文中第 2、9 题两处）
B. adv. 因此（修饰形容词：thus clear）
C. adv. 如此（评注性状语，置于句首：Thus, …，文中第 1、10 题两处）
D. adv. 如此（修饰过去分词：had thus copied it）
E. adv. 因此（句末状语：… thus in public）
F. adv. 因此（句末状语：… thus before dawn，第 6 处）
G. adv. 如此（被动结构中的中位状语：be copied thus）
H. adv. 如此（修饰形容词：be thus careful about the whole business）

answers.why: thus 意为“因此”，此处置于句首作评注性状语，修饰整个句子：Thus, in 1956 …。
thus 意为“因此”，此处置于助动词与过去分词之间修饰动词：had thus begun the ruler。
thus 意为“因此”，此处修饰形容词 clear（清楚）：was thus clear。
thus 意为“如此”，此处修饰过去分词 copied：had thus copied it twice。
thus 意为“因此”，此处置于句末修饰动词：began the ruler thus in public。
thus 意为“因此”，此处亦置于句末：of all who did it that 学期, he did it thus before dawn。
thus 意为“如此”，被动结构 be copied thus 中，副词置于过去分词之后。
thus 意为“如此”，此处修饰形容词 careful（仔细）：be thus careful about the whole business。
thus 意为“因此”，1966 年母亲在无人肯做时又一次开始那件短短的尺子，副词置于动词之后。
thus 意为“如此”，母亲 1968 年那句话以评注性状语开头：Thus, …，修饰整句。

task2.title: Task 2　语境运用
task2.intro: 请把下列句子译成英文，括号里是必须用到的形式。
items: 1956 年，先生如此在黑板开始那件短短的尺子；教室里人人都说那是头一回。（Thus, …）
雨季到来之前，先生已经因此开始那件短短的尺子。（had thus begun …）
那件短短的尺子当时因此清楚。（thus clear）
保管它的那位学童在入冬前已经如此把它照着抄过两回。（had thus copied it）
叔叔因此开始那件短短的尺子，教室里没有一个人怀疑。（… thus …）
在那个学期里做过这件事的人当中，他做得最因此。（the thusest of all of them）
answers: Thus, in 1956 the teacher began the ruler at the blackboard.
Before the March rains the teacher had thus begun the ruler.
The pupil who kept it had thus copied it twice before the winter came.
He began the ruler thus in public, and nobody in the classroom doubted it.
Of all who did it that term, he did it thus before dawn.

task3.title: Task 3　语境写作
task3.intro: 请写 5—6 个句子，至少使用 thus 的 3 种不同位置（句首评注、句中、句末、被动结构中等）；至少使用下列词语中的 3 个。
answers: Thus, in 1956 the teacher began the ruler, and nobody forgot it.
Before the March rains the teacher had thus begun the ruler.
The ruler was thus clear, or so the notebook says.
The pupil had thus copied it twice before the winter came.
My mother began the ruler thus before dawn when nobody else would.
Thus, the classroom never forgot that part of the story.
